Peptides for skin, compared with the proven options.

Peptide Chooser editorial team. Last updated 30 Oct 2026. Every claim links to its source. Prices checked 30 Oct 2026.

Tretinoin is the only option on this page the FDA has approved for fine wrinkles, and it needs a prescription. Peptide creams and serums are cosmetics: legal to sell without approval, judged on small studies of their own. None is a drug and none needs a prescription.

PeptideStatusWhat that means
GHK-Cu, Matrixyl, Argireline (creams and serums)Cosmeticcosmetics are regulated but do not need FDA approval to be sold 5

Approved means the FDA approved a product containing it for a stated use. Not approved means no approved product exists; buying it for yourself is not a crime in the US, but nobody has checked what is in the vial.
